rule: Hint queue: one hint on screen at a time; each frame the first hint (by enum order) whose show test is true is taken; if its done test is already true it is removed silently; otherwise its done test is checked each frame and it completes when true; Skip completes it; the whole queue waits for 8000 ms of total save playtime and never shows during a cutscene; done is stored per hint name in settings (per install). Services appear by context (show test), not by a menu. Objective graph: each objective has parents (runs when all parents are done), flags added or removed on done, markers and an optional logic script; thirteen objective classes including build count, timer and destroy. Sector gates: five requirement types (research, produce, capture, on sector, on planet). Grace: first wave timer is two wave spacings times the campaign difficulty multiplier; groundZero declares a first-wave multiplier of 3 with no reader found in core/src.
keep: One hint on screen at a time, ordered by a fixed priority
Each hint has a show test (context) and a done test (the player did the action)
Hint disappears the moment its done test is true, so the tutorial costs nothing once learned
Services introduced by context, not by a menu of buttons
Objective graph with parents and flags for scripted first-zone goals
Settings switch to turn all hints off
change: Done flag per save, not per install (donor stores it in global settings)
Phone-first first movement hint (donor has move and shoot hints as desktop-only)
Done tests must come from server-verified events; client draws the box only
Add the research pointer or remove the orphan hint text (donor has hint.research with no enum entry)
Wire the first-wave grace multiplier as data and confirm it applies (donor declares 3 on the tutorial zone with no reader in core/src)
look_test: On a 375-wide phone ring fight: three hints in order. (a) Tap to guard appears after 8 seconds of play and clears when the server logs a guard. (b) Hold to power a strike appears when a strike is first available and clears on a strike. (c) A second attacker is coming appears when a second enemy engages and clears on the first hit taken. One visible at a time, Skip on each, 0.6 s fade. Judge: does each hint vanish the moment you do the thing? Score 1 to 5 for knowing what to do next after the first fight.
